philippines.title: Venus Williams suffers 16th defeat in a row with loss to teenager
philippines.description:
GUANGZHOU, China— Tennis great Venus Williams fell to 0-13 in singles matches this year at age 46 after losing 6-2, 6-2 to teenager Lilli Tagger in the Guangzhou Open first round on Tuesday. Their 28-year age gap was reportedly a record difference between opponents in a WTA Tour match. The 18-year-old Austrian Tagger was born in 2008, the year Williams won the last of her seven Grand Slam singles titles at Wimbledon. philippines.title: Checkmate? Barbers says evidence vs VP Sara hard to counter
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte has been checkmated in her impeachment trial as the evidence presented against her is hard to debunk and dispute, prosecution panel spokesperson Robert Ace Barbers said on Tuesday. Barbers, in a press briefing, said it is hard to fathom how the documents and testimonies from government officials will be refuted once Duterte’s lawyers get the chance to present their own evidence and witnesses before the Senate impeachment court. “Well para sa akin, yes, checkmate. Bakit? ’Yon nga ang aking paniwala, napakahirap pasinungalingan (ng ebidensya). Kung ika-counter mo lang naman ’yong mga testigong iniharap natin, […]...
